eventKey.title: Event Key

fieldsFilters.description: The aggregate operation will only be performed for events matching these filters

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: A JSONata expression which will filter out non-matching events

diff.title: Throttle Interval
diff.description: The minimum interval time that can elapse between recording the value of field name. Default is milliseconds per hour.

fieldName.title: Field Name

operator.title: Operator

value.title: OR Filters
value.description: Filters provided will be evaluated using the OR conditional.

field.title: Field Name
